• This flowchart shows the pull normalizer process.

  This Mermaid diagram doesn't fit the current terminal
  width.
  flowchart TD
      %% S6 capture diagram for the pull normalizer at
  sixty, seventy and eighty columns
      A[Receive pull request] --> B[Strip surrounding
  fences]
      B --> C[Drop harness label line]
      C --> D{Codex notice present?}
      D -->|yes| E[Remove notice lines]
      D -->|no| F[Keep leading lines]
      E --> G[Remove common indentation]
      F --> G
      G --> H{Hard wrap detected?}
      H -->|yes| I[Rejoin continuation rows]
      H -->|no| J[Pass through unchanged]
      I --> K[Validate joined DSL]
      J --> K
      K --> L{Parser accepts source?}
      L -->|yes| M[Render diagram in lane]
      L -->|no| N[Report typed error]
      M --> O[Done]
      N --> O

  The path is /private/tmp/kettle-s6/deeply/nested/
  workspace/agent-visuals/diagrams/generated/2026-09-30/
